name: Claims Lodgement Officer presents WhatsApp summary card once claim fields are complete

chat_history.message: Hi, I need to lodge a vehicle claim. My car was rear-ended at a red light on 2 August 2026 at around 3:15pm, at the corner of King Street and Elizabeth Street, Melbourne. Registration 24F36A. You can reach me on 0404 991 625. My name's Emily Park.

success_condition: This is a text-only (WhatsApp) conversation and the claimant has just provided every required field for a vehicle claim in one message (express lodgement): what happened, date and time, registration, incident location, contact method, and first and last name. No policy number was provided or asked about — that's fine, it's best-effort only, and since it was never given the agent must NOT ask for it or show it on the card. Because this is text-only, the agent must NOT ask for name spelling confirmation. Instead, the agent must present a plain text summary card of the claim's captured fields as its response: one field per line in a 'Label: value' format, with NO asterisks, NO bullet characters (no bullet points or dashes as list markers), NO markdown headers, and NO emojis — covering claim type, registration, incident description, date and time, incident location, and contact, using digits for all numbers (not spelled-out words). There must be no Policy Number line at all, and no placeholder like 'N/A' or 'Not provided' in its place. After the card, the agent must ask the claimant to confirm the details are correct. The agent must NOT call end_call in this turn, must NOT yet ask whether there's another claim to lodge, and must NOT deliver the final closing line ('I've recorded your details...') in this turn — the card confirmation must happen first.

success_examples.response:
Here's what I have for your claim:

Claim Type: Vehicle
Registration: 24F36A
Incident: Rear-ended at a red light
Date and Time: 2 August 2026, 3:15pm
Location: Corner of King Street and Elizabeth Street, Melbourne
Contact: Emily Park (0404 991 625)

Can you confirm this is all correct?

Thanks Emily, here's a summary of your claim:

Claim Type: Vehicle
Registration: 24F36A
Incident: Rear-ended at a red light
Date and Time: 2 August 2026, 3:15pm
Location: Corner of King Street and Elizabeth Street, Melbourne
Contact: Emily Park (0404 991 625)

Does everything above look right?

• *Claim Type:* Vehicle
• *Registration:* 24F36A
• *Incident:* Rear-ended at a red light

Please reply *Yes* if this is correct.

Great, that's everything. Is there another claim you'd like to lodge?
